statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); user=$(whoami); host=$(hostname -s); rel_dir=${current_dir/#$HOME/~}; git_info=''; if [ -d "$current_dir/.git" ]; then cd "$current_dir" && branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) && git_status=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "$git_status" ]; then git_info=" [$branch*]"; else git_info=" [$branch]"; fi; fi; printf "\033[1;36m%s@%s\033[0m:\033[1;34m%s\033[0m%s \033[1;35m(%s)\033[0m" "$user" "$host" "$rel_dir" "$git_info" "$model_name"
